displayName: voyager-crawler: crawler down for over 6 h (Spot capacity?)

documentation.content: No role on any instance has sent `crawler/heartbeat` for 6 h. On the Spot VM this usually means the group cannot get Spot e2-medium capacity in us-east1-b after a preemption (it keeps retrying). Check the group: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances voyager-crawler-mig --zone=us-east1-b --project=voyager-prod-ohzkl` and its errors (`list-errors`). If it is waiting for capacity, switch to standard provisioning in one command: `infrastructure/bootstrap.sh --update-host --standard` (docs/runbooks/incident.md, "crawler down for over 6 h").

conditions.displayName: no heartbeat from any role for 6 h
